extraction.Name: Mark Wells
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent, but wanted the land to continue in trust, but that he was told that if he did not take it, that the land would be taxed anyway and if he did not pay the taxes, that the land would be sold to satisfy them
extraction.Recorded patent: Wells did not record patent and does not know who did
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to McKenny & Allen, Co. Sioux Falls, S.D. for $700.00; brother Philip Wells bought the land when foreclosure was threatened; no equity left for deponent, all he received was the $700.00; deponent believes land was worth about $2000.00
extraction.Occupation/Income: I get a little income from the cattle, and do all odd jobs I can find to do, such as common labor and working on farms and on the highways
extraction.NOTES: Mentally competent and in good health; has no land; owns a half interest in about 50 head of cattle valued at about $1250.00; father and mother, ages 78 and 63 respectively, are dependent on him for support; was in military service when he received the patent; mortgaged land to help his father; document sworn October 31, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge (Shannon County, South Dakota)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
